    set-verification <plan-id> <name> <status>      Update verification status

    add-log <plan-id> <action>                      Write a log entry           
    write-revision <plan-id>                        Write a revision file from

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Run a promptware directly

USAGE:
    Ivy.Tendril.dll promptware run <promptware> [args] [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    <promptware>    Promptware name (e.g., UpdateProject)                       
    [args]          Free-form arguments passed to the promptware as the Args    
                    firmware value                                              

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help               Prints help information                            
        --profile            Override the agent profile (e.g., deep, balanced,  
                             quick)                                             
        --working-dir        Working directory for the agent process            
        --value              Additional firmware header values (key=value,      
                             repeatable)                                        
        --plan               Plan ID or folder path                             
        --promptware-path    Additional directory to search for promptware      
                             folders                                            
        --config             Override config.yaml path (for testing)            
        --agent              Override agent provider (claude, antigravity,      
                             codex, copilot, opencode)                          
        --cli-log            Path to write CLI invocation log (JSONL)           
        --dry-run            Print the compiled firmware and exit without       
                             launching the agent
